schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

Stateless search: parsed filters, ranked books with live availability, and, when
nothing matches every hard filter, which one to drop and how many books that gives.

get.description:
One book for the drawer: the card's facts with live availability, the description,
its tags, its editions and where every copy is.

post.description:
Any text as speech (a 16-bit WAV, 24 kHz, Kokoro), for demos and checks. 503 when
the TTS model isn't downloaded (`make download-tts`).

get.description:
The benchmark dashboard's data: the newest dev-split retrieval report (every system's
scores with CIs, per category, latency) and the newest parser report.
The landing page's moving shelf: popular books with a cover, in a fixed order.

schema.title: Response Featured Api V1 Featured Get

get.description: Every genre in the catalog with its number of books, largest first (Explore).

schema.title: Response Genres Api V1 Genres Get

post.description: A new anonymous conversation; its state expires after `session_ttl_s` idle.

schema.title: Response Start Session Api V1 Sessions Post

post.description:
One message: merged into the session's state, routed by intent, answered with
books (cards from the catalog, never from the LLM) and short template notes.
Back to the search before the last "new topic".

The reader tapped a chip's remove button: its constraints go, and the search runs
again on what is left.

The reader switched a chip between must (a filter) and preferred (a ranking nudge);
the search runs again. Only chips marked `switchable` change.

Explore a genre: a new search (undo-able) for its books, those on the shelf now and
most borrowed first. No parsing.

The filters form: page limit, years and "available now" as musts on the current
search (or the start of one). No parsing.

The "Surprise me" button: three unseen books on the shelf now, within the hard
chips. No parsing.

"More like this" (the book becomes the seed) or "less like this" (it is hidden and
the books nearest it pushed down) on a shown book; the search runs again.

delete.description: "New visitor" / forget me: the state is deleted now, not at expiry.

BookDetail.title: BookDetail
BookDetail.description: Everything the book drawer shows: the card's facts plus the record behind them.

BookFeedback.title: BookFeedback
BookFeedback.description: "More like this" / "less like this" on a shown book.

Chip.title: Chip
Chip.description:
An active constraint as the UI shows it; removable by naming its field and label.
`switchable`: it means something both as a must (filter) and as a preference (nudge), so
the reader may switch it; "available now" only filters and themes only nudge.

ChipRemoval.title: ChipRemoval
ChipRemoval.description: The chip to take away, as the response showed it: its field and label.

ChipStrength.title: ChipStrength
ChipStrength.description: Switch a chip to must ("hard") or preferred ("soft"), named as the response showed it.

Constraint.title: Constraint
Constraint.description:
One requirement or preference.

`field` names what is constrained: "pages", "year" (the work's original publication year),
"available_now", "isbn", "genre", "facet.supernatural", ...

ExploreRequest.title: ExploreRequest
ExploreRequest.description: Explore: browse one genre (a name from `GET /genres`).

FeaturedBook.title: FeaturedBook
FeaturedBook.description: A book on the landing page's moving shelf, with its Open Library cover id.

FiltersRequest.title: FiltersRequest
FiltersRequest.description: The filters form: each field set becomes a must; `available_now` false drops that one.

GroundingRates.title: GroundingRates
GroundingRates.description: Share of a system's answers with each problem (set E, `evaluation.grounding`).

Guess.title: Guess
Guess.description: "Did you mean...": a catalog title or author for a name that didn't match.

Inspector.title: Inspector
Inspector.description:
The pipeline inspector's view of a turn (design doc §22.2): how the message was read,
what was searched, and the candidates at each stage. Timings are in `timings_ms`.

LookupSpec.title: LookupSpec
LookupSpec.description: A known item: a title, an author's books, or both. Canonical spellings, not as typed.

SurpriseRequest.title: SurpriseRequest
SurpriseRequest.description: The "Surprise me" button: picks from what is on the shelf, within the hard chips.

VoiceCondition.title: VoiceCondition
VoiceCondition.description: One run of the spoken questions (`make measure`), avatar on or off; times in ms.
